info.title: calendly (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Simulated calendly API for benchmarking. Derived from public documentation; no live service is called.

get.summary: Retrieve scheduled events (meetings, appointments, and bookings). Supports filtering by user, invitee email, date range,
get.description: Retrieve scheduled events (meetings, appointments, and bookings). Supports filtering by user, invitee email, date range, or status.

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: Limit results to events belonging to the organization at this URI.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Limit results to events for the user at this URI. Required when organization is not provided.

parameters.name: invitee_email
parameters.description: Limit results to events that include the specified invitee email.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Narrow results to events with this status.

parameters.name: min_start_time
parameters.description: Return only events starting at or after this ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

parameters.name: max_start_time
parameters.description: Return only events starting before this ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of records per page (1â€“100, default 20).

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Continuation token for the next page of results.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order results by start_time. Accepted values: 'start_time:asc' or 'start_time:desc'.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Limit results to events for the group at this URI.

get.summary: Fetch complete details for a single scheduled event by its UUID, including time, location, host, and invitee counts.
get.description: Fetch complete details for a single scheduled event by its UUID, including time, location, host, and invitee counts.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: UUID of the scheduled event to retrieve.

post.summary: Cancel a scheduled event. Generates a cancellation record and sends notifications to all invitees.
post.description: Cancel a scheduled event. Generates a cancellation record and sends notifications to all invitees.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: UUID of the scheduled event to cancel.

get.summary: List all invitees on a scheduled event, including their booking status, contact details, and question responses.
get.description: List all invitees on a scheduled event, including their booking status, contact details, and question responses.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: UUID of the scheduled event whose invitees to list.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of records per page (1â€“100, default 20).

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Narrow results to invitees matching this exact email address.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Continuation token for the next page of results.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order results. Accepted values: 'created_at:asc' or 'created_at:desc'.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Narrow results to invitees with this status.

post.summary: Flag an invitee as a no-show. Registers that the attendee did not appear for their scheduled meeting.
post.description: Flag an invitee as a no-show. Registers that the attendee did not appear for their scheduled meeting.

requestBody.description: Body: {invitee (required, string â€” full URI of the invitee, e.g. https://api.calendly.com/scheduled_events/{event_uuid}/invitees/{invitee_uuid})}

get.summary: List the available meeting types and scheduling page configurations for a user or organization.
get.description: List the available meeting types and scheduling page configurations for a user or organization.

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: Return event types for the organization at this URI.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Return event types for the user at this URI.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: When provided, filters to only active or only inactive event types.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of records per page (1â€“100, default 20).

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Continuation token for the next page of results.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order results. Accepted values: 'name:asc' or 'name:desc'.

get.summary: Fetch a Calendly user by UUID, or supply 'me' to get the authenticated user. Returns the user's profile, scheduling URL,
get.description: Fetch a Calendly user by UUID, or supply 'me' to get the authenticated user. Returns the user's profile, scheduling URL, and timezone.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: UUID of the user, or 'me' for the currently authenticated user.

post.summary: Generate a one-time meeting link. Creates a unique scheduling URL for a standalone meeting that is not tied to a recurri
post.description: Generate a one-time meeting link. Creates a unique scheduling URL for a standalone meeting that is not tied to a recurring event type.

requestBody.description: {name: string, host: string, duration: integer, start_date: string, end_date: string, co_hosts: [string], timezone: string, location_kind: string, location_location: string, location_additional_info: string}

post.summary: Schedule a Calendly meeting by generating a booking link for an event type. When invitee_email is provided, this also cr
post.description: Schedule a Calendly meeting by generating a booking link for an event type. When invitee_email is provided, this also creates the scheduled event and invitee record immediately (simulating a completed booking). Use this endpoint to book meetings, schedule appointments, or create events with specific invitees.

requestBody.description: Body: {max_event_count (required, integer â€” number of allowed bookings, typically 1), owner (required, string â€” event type URI or ID), owner_type (required, string â€” 'EventType'), invitee_email (optional, string â€” primary invitee email used to auto-create a scheduled event and invitee record), event_guests (optional, array of guest email strings or objects with an email field â€” additional attendees on that same event), name (optional, string â€” custom event name override, e.g. 'Vendor Site Visit - Acme Corp'), start_time (optional, string â€” ISO 8601 datetime for the event start), end_time (optional, string â€” ISO 8601 datetime for the event end)}

uri.description: API resource path for this scheduled event.

status.description: Indicates whether the event is currently active or has been canceled.

start_time.description: When the event is scheduled to begin, in UTC.

end_time.description: When the event is scheduled to conclude, in UTC.

event_type.description: URI referencing the event type this event was booked from.

event_memberships.description: Host memberships for this event, each containing a user URI.

uri.description: API resource path for this invitee record.

status.description: Whether the invitee's booking is active or has been canceled.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for the invitee.

event.description: URI of the event this invitee is associated with.

cancel_url.description: URL the invitee can use to cancel their booking.

reschedule_url.description: URL the invitee can use to reschedule their booking.

no_show.description: No-show record for this invitee if they missed the event, or null if they attended.

uri.description: API resource path for this event type.

name.description: Human-readable label for this event type.

active.description: Whether this event type is currently accepting bookings.

slug.description: URL-friendly identifier used in the scheduling page address.

scheduling_url.description: Public URL where invitees can book this event type.

duration.description: Length of each session in minutes.

kind.description: Whether this event type is for one-on-one or group meetings.

color.description: Hexadecimal color code used on the scheduling page.

description_plain.description: Plain-text description of the event type.

description_html.description: HTML-formatted description of the event type.

uri.description: API resource path for this user.

scheduling_url.description: URL of the user's Calendly booking page.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for the user.

slug.description: URL segment used in the user's scheduling page address.

avatar_url.description: URL pointing to the user's profile picture.

current_organization.description: URI of the organization this user currently belongs to.

location.description: The actual location value, whose meaning depends on the type.

uri.description: API resource path for this no-show record.

invitee.description: URI of the invitee whose no-show is being recorded.

canceled_by.description: Name of the person who initiated the cancellation.

reason.description: Explanation provided for canceling the event.

canceler_type.description: Indicates whether the host or the invitee canceled the event.

count.description: Number of records included in the current page.

next_page.description: URL to request the next page of results.

previous_page.description: URL to request the previous page of results.

next_page_token.description: Token to supply as page_token to fetch the next page.
